title: AI Content Detector (Self-Portrait)
summary: A working AI-text detector that can only examine itself, and always confesses it was written by a machine — because it was.
mechanism: Client-side regex stylometry over the page's own rendered textContent marks the 'tells' of LLM prose live and returns a foregone verdict; no network, no storage.
references: Alan Turing, Computing Machinery and Intelligence (1950) / the imitation game
the AI-text-detector discourse (GPTZero & the 'em-dash / delve' panic, 2023–)
Roland Barthes, The Death of the Author (1967)
